C0810.title: 3CX Software Supply Chain Attack
C0810.summary: In March 2023, CISA issued an alert stating that open-source reports described a software supply chain attack against 3CXDesktopApp. The voice and video conferencing application had been trojanized, potentially leading to multi-stage attacks against users running vulnerable versions. CISA urged users and organizations to review the reports and hunt for the published indicators of compromise.

references.title: Supply Chain Attack Against 3CXDesktopApp — CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency) Official Alert
